test_cases.test_name: X-bar/R Chart Creation and Nelson Rules Application
test_cases.objective: Verify the system can create X-bar/R charts from CSV inputs and apply Nelson rules correctly.
prerequisites: CSV file with sample QC data

test_steps.action: Upload a CSV file containing QC data via the dashboard interface.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts the file and displays a preview of the data.

test_steps.action: Select 'X-bar/R chart' from the chart options and configure the chart settings.
test_steps.expected_result: System generates an X-bar/R chart based on the uploaded data.

test_steps.action: Enable Nelson rules from the vendor's standard options.
test_steps.expected_result: System applies Nelson rules to the chart and highlights any out-of-control points.

acceptance_criteria: X-bar/R chart is generated correctly from the CSV input.
Nelson rules are applied and out-of-control points are highlighted.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must remain unchanged during processing.
required_expertise: Basic knowledge of SPC charts and Nelson rules

test_cases.test_name: Scheduled Report Email and Role-Based Access Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify the system can send scheduled reports via email and enforce role-based view access.

test_steps.action: Configure a scheduled report email using the vendor's scheduler.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts the schedule and confirms the configuration.

test_steps.action: Log in as a user with restricted view access and attempt to access a report.
test_steps.expected_result: System enforces role-based access and restricts unauthorized views.

test_steps.action: Verify the scheduled report email is received at the designated time.
test_steps.expected_result: Email is received with the correct report attached.

acceptance_criteria: Scheduled report email is sent successfully at the configured time.
Role-based access controls restrict unauthorized views as expected.
data_integrity_requirements: Report data must match the original dataset.
required_expertise: Knowledge of email scheduling and AD integration

test_cases.test_name: Verify X-bar/R Chart Creation from CSV Input
test_cases.objective: To ensure that the system correctly creates X-bar/R charts from CSV inputs as specified in URS-020-001.

test_steps.action: Upload the CSV file containing QC data to the SPC dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: The system should successfully upload the CSV file and display the data.

test_steps.action: Select the option to create an X-bar/R chart from the uploaded data.
test_steps.expected_result: The system should generate an X-bar/R chart based on the uploaded data.

acceptance_criteria: The X-bar/R chart is correctly generated and matches the input data.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure data integrity during CSV upload and chart generation.

test_cases.objective: To verify that the system can send scheduled report emails using the vendor scheduler as specified in URS-020-006.

test_steps.action: Set up a scheduled report email using the vendor scheduler.
test_steps.expected_result: The system should successfully configure the scheduled report email.

test_steps.action: Wait for the scheduled time and check the email inbox for the report.
test_steps.expected_result: The scheduled report email should be received at the specified time.

acceptance_criteria: The scheduled report email is received and contains the correct report.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure data integrity during report generation and email transmission.

test_cases.test_name: Verify X-bar/R Chart Creation from CSV Input
test_cases.objective: Ensure the system correctly generates X-bar/R charts from CSV input files as specified in URS-020-001.
prerequisites: CSV file with valid QC data

test_steps.action: Log in to the SPC dashboard with a valid user account.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and accesses the dashboard.

test_steps.action: Navigate to the chart creation section and select 'X-bar/R chart'.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the X-bar/R chart creation interface.

test_steps.action: Upload a predefined CSV file containing QC data.
test_steps.expected_result: System processes the CSV file and displays the X-bar/R chart.

acceptance_criteria: X-bar/R chart is generated without errors.
Chart accurately reflects the data from the CSV file.
Total processing time is less than 5 seconds for 100k data points.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be accurately represented in the chart.

test_cases.objective: Verify that the system enforces role-based view access as specified in URS-020-004.
prerequisites: Multiple user accounts with different roles

test_steps.action: Log in to the SPC dashboard with a user account having 'Viewer' role.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and accesses the dashboard.

test_steps.action: Attempt to access the chart creation section.
test_steps.expected_result: System denies access and displays an appropriate error message.

test_steps.action: Log in with a user account having 'Admin' role.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and accesses all features.

acceptance_criteria: System correctly restricts access based on user roles.
Error messages are clear and appropriate.
Admin users have full access to all features.
data_integrity_requirements: User roles must be accurately enforced.
